title: Snapshot the working tree at session start without touching files, index or stash
body: Commit through a temporary index (git stash create skipped untracked files). Kept alive by refs/bulletproof/<session>. Tests: test/snapshot.test.ts.

title: Record each session's edited files so other windows' edits are never blamed
body: Append-only .edits log per session, safe when the agent runs edit tools in parallel (12 concurrent hook processes in test/hooks.test.ts).

title: Plain code checks on added lines
body: One-off Tailwind values, hard-coded colors, inline fixed styles, !important, plain elements where components/ui has a primitive, and lint-disable comments (warned, never hiding the problem). Tests: test/checks.test.ts.

title: Find affected pages by following imports back to app-router pages and layouts
body: oxc-parser + oxc-resolver with tsconfig paths; static, re-export and dynamic imports; layouts reach every page below them; route groups dropped; dynamic routes need a sample URL or are listed as not checked. About 200ms on Stanford Root.

title: Before/after copies with dev servers and Playwright screenshots
body: Copy-on-write node_modules (about 8s on Stanford Root), phone + desktop, light + dark, frozen clock, dev badge hidden. Hard failures: new console errors, failed requests, pages that stop loading, sideways scrolling.

title: Judge via the developer's own CLI, headless and read-only
body: claude -p --tools Read --json-schema; before | after crops with changes outlined. About 13s and $0.04-0.06 per check. Screenshots the judge did not open are listed as not checked.

title: Stop hook gate: block with findings up to 3 rounds, then allow with a review link
body: Rounds reset on each new developer message. A Bulletproof crash prints 'not checked' and exits 0.

title: Static review page per run
body: Problems, questions, not checked, judge summary, labeled before/after images. Works in light and dark.

title: Fixture Next.js app and end-to-end breaking cases
body: fixtures/next-app plus test/e2e.test.ts: sideways scroll, thrown error, another window's edits, judge skipped/crashed, dev server that never starts, change that breaks rendering.

title: Cursor adapter
body: Snapshot on the first beforeSubmitPrompt (sessionStart does not wait), record afterFileEdit paths, answer stop with followup_message.

title: Codex adapter
body: SessionStart, PostToolUse with paths parsed from apply_patch text, Stop block. Judge via codex exec --output-schema.

title: Signed-in pages: login once, reuse the session, never pass on an expired login
body: bulletproof-ui login saves Playwright storage state. A redirect to the sign-in page means not checked, not passed.

title: Clicked-into states: menus, dialogs, filters, empty and error states
body: Config lists states per route as small action scripts; screenshot each.

title: Taste profile mined from my past complaints, reverts and screenshots
body: Editable taste files, one per developer and one per app, read by the judge.

title: Local review server with yes/no answers saved as taste rules
body: 127.0.0.1 only. GET /runs/:id, GET /api/runs/:id, POST /api/runs/:id/answers. Unsure judge calls become questions.

title: References: compare against a screenshot, URL or Figma frame
body: 'Make it look like this' input passed to the judge with the after screenshots.

title: Get the median check on Stanford Root under 2 minutes
body: Alpha measured 109s on a one-page FAQ change: 21s copies, 55s dev servers, 17s screenshots, 14s judge. Prepare copies and start servers at the first UI edit in the background; keep them warm across rounds.

title: Replay set of past UI complaints to measure catch rate and false alarms
body: Targets: flag 80%+ of past complaints, 10% or fewer of changes I kept. Rerun in CI whenever the judge prompt changes.

title: Calibrate the judge's block vs unsure line
body: In the alpha the judge blocked a link spacing choice I'd have accepted (it was right about a stray empty div). Use the replay set to tune the prompt.

title: Flag Tailwind default palette colors when the app defines its own theme
body: bg-blue-500 passed the code checks in the alpha demo even though the app's theme has its own brand color.

title: Track edits the agent makes through Bash (sed, mv, codegen)
body: Only Edit/Write/MultiEdit/NotebookEdit are recorded today, so a sed edit is not checked.

title: Tell content that only moved from content that changed
body: Adding a line near the top marks the whole page as changed. Detect pure vertical shifts so the judge sees the real change.

title: Handle fixed and sticky elements in full-page screenshots
body: Stanford Root's help button lands at a random spot in full-page shots and overlapped a heading after the page shifted.

title: Pick sample URLs for dynamic routes automatically
body: Use generateStaticParams or recent links instead of requiring a routes entry.

title: Publish to npm with trusted publishing
body: Node will not strip types inside node_modules, so build to JS first. GitHub Actions publishes on tag.

title: AI code review on every PR and track which comments caught real bugs
body: Plus my own review. Count true and false catches for the report.

title: Coverage report in CI
body: Document coverage for the Testing & Quality section.

title: Support Vite/Remix and the Next pages router
body: Route discovery and dev command detection beyond the Next app router.
